summary: A mixed day driven by regulatory action against a former Kerala CM and major retail/Reliance capital moves. ED tells court police must file FIR against ex-CM Pinarayi Vijayan in CMRL Exalogic case; separately, Reliance lines up $1 billion local currency bond sale.

bullets.text: ED tells Kerala High Court police must register FIR against ex-CM Pinarayi Vijayan in CMRL Exalogic case.
Reliance Industries plans up to $1 billion local currency bond sale, its second fundraise in three weeks.
J Infratech files IPO papers targeting Rs 600 crore via fresh share issuance.
Swiss Beauty Select projects over 100% growth, targeting Rs 70+ crore revenue by FY26-27.
Decathlon targets Rs 1,000 crore running sports business in four years; opens first northeast store in Guwahati.
